instruction: Adversarial CORRECTNESS-lens review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020H part 3 (ADOPT-001 §12.7 federation-primitive adopter integration appendix). SCP-E006 in particular: the workflow emits `::error::` annotations but the python step doesn't `exit 1` after the loop — verify whether 'Non-blocking' is technically correct (step exits 0) but potentially misleading (annotation shows red X in PR UI). (8) §12.7.9 pre-commit hook references `scripts/scp-policy-check`; verify the script exists at that path and supports the invocation shape shown. The heredoc `EOF` and `chmod +x` are syntactically correct bash. (9) §12.7.11 freshness-warning is correctly flagged as **lands in 020H.1, not yet emitted at v1.0.0** — confirm the wording is unambiguous about what is and is NOT shipped at v1.0.0. (10) DISPATCH-NOTE.md sub-criterion checklist mapping (i)..(xi) accurately corresponds to plan §4 020H part 3 row's 11 sub-sections. (11) Decision references (D-029, D-031..D-035) cited in the appendix exist in `docs/DECISIONS.md`. (12) The fenced code blocks render correctly inside Markdown (no nested-fence collisions; closing-tag balance correct). Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
